title: DiDi Starts Driverless Passenger Trials With R2 Robotaxi
summary: Passengers in parts of Beijing and Guangzhou can now summon DiDi’s purpose-built R2, equipped with 33 sensors and redundant controls.
body:
## A purpose-built vehicle enters passenger service

DiDi Autonomous Driving has begun fully driverless passenger trials with its next-generation R2 robotaxi in designated areas of Beijing and Guangzhou. Eligible users can request the vehicle through DiDi’s service, moving the R2 from road qualification and closed testing into public-facing operation without a safety driver inside.

Developed jointly with GAC Aion, the R2 is a dedicated robotaxi rather than a consumer car retrofitted after production. It uses DiDi’s full-stack Level 4 driving system and carries 33 sensors, including lidar, cameras, 4D millimetre-wave radar, infrared cameras and acoustic sensors. Their inputs are combined through sensor fusion to provide coverage around the vehicle and additional visibility in difficult lighting or weather.

A three-domain integrated computing platform coordinates autonomous-driving, cockpit and vehicle-control functions. DiDi says the vehicle incorporates redundant braking, steering, communications and power systems, while the underlying vehicle platform was designed to meet five-star Chinese and European safety standards. The passenger compartment has been optimized for rear-seat use, including seats with a wider reclining range.

The service remains geographically constrained and is still described as a trial, so the announcement does not amount to broad commercial deployment. DiDi has not disclosed the fleet size, daily ride capacity, intervention rate or timetable for expansion. Those figures will be necessary to compare the R2’s operating maturity with established robotaxi fleets.

## Why it matters

DiDi controls one of the world’s largest ride-hailing networks, giving it a potentially powerful route from autonomous-vehicle testing to customer demand, dispatch data and fleet operations. Introducing a purpose-built vehicle in two major cities tests whether that network can become an advantage in driverless transport rather than simply a source of app traffic.

The important threshold is operational replication. If DiDi can add vehicles and service zones without proportionally increasing remote assistance, maintenance and safety staffing, the R2 could strengthen China’s already crowded robotaxi sector. Until fleet and intervention data are published, however, public availability demonstrates product integration more clearly than commercial scalability.
title_zh: 滴滴新一代R2 Robotaxi开启无人载客测试
summary_zh: 滴滴与广汽埃安联合打造的R2已在北京、广州部分区域开放呼叫，搭载33个传感器及多重安全冗余系统。
body_zh:
## 专用Robotaxi进入公开载客阶段

滴滴自动驾驶新一代Robotaxi R2已在北京、广州指定区域开启全无人载客测试。符合条件的用户可以通过滴滴服务呼叫车辆，R2由此从道路准入和封闭测试阶段，进入车内不设安全员的公众体验环节。

R2由滴滴自动驾驶与广汽埃安联合开发，并非在量产乘用车上后装设备，而是面向Robotaxi运营专门设计。车辆采用滴滴L4级全栈自动驾驶方案，共搭载33个传感器，包括激光雷达、摄像头、4D毫米波雷达、红外相机和声音传感器。不同传感器的数据通过融合处理，为车辆周围环境提供完整感知，并增强复杂光线及天气条件下的识别能力。

三域融合计算平台统一协调自动驾驶、智能座舱和车辆控制。滴滴表示，R2在制动、转向、通信和供电等关键系统上设置了冗余，整车平台按照中欧双五星安全标准开发。车内空间则重点服务后排乘客，座椅支持更大角度调节。

这项服务仍限于特定区域，官方定位也是测试，因此尚不等同于大规模商业运营。滴滴没有披露投入车辆数量、每日可提供的订单量、人工远程介入频率或扩区时间表。这些数据将决定R2能否与已经形成稳定车队的Robotaxi运营商进行有效比较。

## 为何重要

滴滴拥有全球规模领先的网约车网络，可以直接连接乘客需求、派单数据和车队运营。这使其具备一条从自动驾驶测试走向实际订单的特殊通道。R2进入两座大型城市，检验的正是既有出行网络能否转化为无人驾驶运营优势，而不只是应用流量入口。

接下来值得关注的是复制效率。如果滴滴扩大车队和服务区域时，不需要同步增加同等比例的远程协助、维护及安全人员，R2将可能改变中国Robotaxi市场的竞争结构。在公布车队规模和介入数据前，此次上线证明的主要是产品整合能力，尚非商业模式已经跑通。
